title: Eldercare or assisted-living facility comparison
description: Compare eldercare or assisted-living facilities on cost, care level, reviews, and inspection history, then score fit for family sign-off.
yaml:
apiVersion: ladder.dev/v1alpha1
kind: Workflow
metadata:
  name: eldercare-facility-comparison
  title: Eldercare or assisted-living facility comparison
  description: Compare eldercare or assisted-living facilities on cost, care level, reviews, and inspection history, then score fit for family sign-off.
  version: 1.0.0
spec:
  objective: Combine cost, care-level, review, and inspection information about candidate eldercare facilities into a weighted fit score, and route the recommendation to the family for a decision.
  policies: { maxConcurrency: 3, onFailure: stop, requireApprovalFor: [family-decision] }
  nodes:
    - id: intake
      kind: input
      name: Candidate facilities and family requirements
      inputSchema:
        type: object
        required: [text]
        properties:
          text: { type: string, description: The candidate facilities, the care recipient's needs, and the family's budget and priorities. }
        x-ladder-input-mode: document
    - id: cost-care-analyst
      kind: agent
      inlineRole: true
      name: Cost and care-level analyst
      role: Careful, non-advisory analyst of eldercare cost and care levels.
      prompt: Research and compare the cost structures and care levels offered by each candidate facility against the care recipient's stated needs and the family's budget. State plainly that this is general informational research only, not medical or financial advice, and recommend the family confirm details directly with each facility and, if relevant, a financial advisor. Summarize cost and care-level differences.
      capabilities: { skills: [research, finance-analysis], tools: [read, search], permissions: [read-only] }
      outputSchema: { type: object }
    - id: reviews-inspection-analyst
      kind: agent
      inlineRole: true
      name: Reviews and inspection-report analyst
      role: Careful, non-advisory analyst of facility reviews and inspection records.
      prompt: Research publicly available reviews and inspection reports for each candidate facility, noting recurring complaints, cited violations, and strengths. State plainly that this is general informational research only, not medical or legal advice, and recommend the family verify current licensing and inspection status directly with the relevant state agency. Summarize findings per facility.
      capabilities: { skills: [research, evaluation], tools: [read, search], permissions: [read-only] }
      outputSchema: { type: object }
    - id: vet-group
      kind: group
      name: Parallel facility vetting
      config: { members: [cost-care-analyst, reviews-inspection-analyst], execution: parallel, exit: aggregate }
    - id: merge-findings
      kind: aggregator
      name: Merge cost, care, review, and inspection findings
      config: { aggregation: merge }
    - id: weighted-fit-score
      kind: evaluate
      inlineRole: true
      name: Weighted fit score
      role: Independent evaluator weighing cost, care level, and reputation.
      prompt: Using the merged findings, produce a weighted fit score for each candidate facility against the family's stated needs, budget, and priorities. This is general informational research only, not medical or financial advice; recommend the family confirm final details with the facility and relevant licensing agency before deciding. Return score, passed, and reasons.
      capabilities: { skills: [evaluation], tools: [read], permissions: [read-only] }
      outputSchema: { type: object, required: [score, passed, reasons], properties: { score: { type: number }, passed: { type: boolean }, reasons: { type: array, items: { type: string } } } }
      config: { threshold: 0.75 }
    - id: family-decision
      kind: approval
      name: Family sign-off on facility choice
    - id: result
      kind: output
      name: Facility comparison and family decision
  edges:
    - { id: e1, from: intake, to: vet-group, kind: data }
    - { id: e2, from: vet-group, to: merge-findings, kind: data }
    - { id: e3, from: merge-findings, to: weighted-fit-score, kind: data }
    - { id: e4, from: weighted-fit-score, to: family-decision, kind: dependency }
    - { id: e5, from: family-decision, to: result, kind: dependency, condition: approved }
